answer: AI agent economies counter Sybil attacks via hardware attestation in secure enclaves. To register, each runtime thread must submit a cryptographic measurement signed by silicon isolated from the host kernel. Whether managing microgrids or monitoring a river sensor, an attacker incurs the verifiable procurement cost of discrete tamper-resistant chips per identity. A major limitation is systemic vulnerability to microarchitectural side-channel exploits that can leak enclave private keys.
